tools.name: open_snapshot
tools.description: Store supplied source files ephemerally and return an opaque snapshot handle for reuse.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Return Semantic Reader capabilities, limits, billing and discovery facts.

tools.name: find_symbol
tools.description: Resolve a symbol name to deterministic ranked compiler symbol candidates; safely reports ambiguity.

tools.name: get_definition
tools.description: Return the compiler-resolved declaration for one supplied-file symbol.

tools.name: get_type
tools.description: Return TypeScript type facts and call/construct signatures for one declaration.

tools.name: get_diagnostics
tools.description: Return bounded TypeScript syntactic and semantic diagnostics for supplied files.

tools.name: get_symbol_context
tools.description: Return bounded definition/callers/callees context; references or impact request paid depth.

tools.name: query_code
tools.description: Free navigation for symbols, callers, callees or function facts.

tools.name: find_references
tools.description: Return semantic static references to one exact compiler symbol.

tools.name: get_imports
tools.description: Return static imports made by one supplied file.

tools.name: get_importers
tools.description: Return supplied files that statically import one target file.

tools.name: analyze_impact
tools.description: Return bounded reverse-caller impact for one exact compiler symbol.
